content:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning a pinwave for API + runtime + router tomorrow 05:00 UTC. This is to roll kernel batching and router header split together. deploy-bot will run staged canaries.
elaine: Thumbs-up. What's our rollback trigger here?
sam: Primary: canary error rate > 2% for 10m OR median p50 latency regression > 30ms vs baseline. Also we watch tail p99 for router paths.
nate: Add request-rate drop > 15% as a safety net (could mean traffic steering bug).
maria: Console owners — please freeze release notes UI changes until we confirm schema compatibility. Small blurb ready, will update after canary pass.
console-team: noted. We'll disable the notes auto-publish and hold manual release after green canary.
deploy-bot: @channel Deploy plan scheduled: 05:00 UTC. Stages: canary(2 pods, 10%) -> canary(10%) -> ramp(50%) -> full. Health checks: /health, trace-sample validation, kv-cache warm.
elaine: For the runtime kernel flip, ensure the kv cache warm timeout is 120s in canaries to avoid cold-cache noise.
sam: Agreed. Set KV_WARM_TIMEOUT=120 for canary envs. Also ensure continuous-batching param stays at 64 for canaries.
ops-oncall: I will be on standby. Add me to the incident link in release notes and attach a quick rollback runbook.
maria: Rollback runbook: how to pin versions and revert routing: snippet below
```
# rollback commands
# pin runtime to previous image
redwoodctl deploy pin runtime --service=runtime --rev=sha:abcdef --reason="rollback after canary"
# update router to route to stable variant
redwoodctl router set-variant --route=api-main --variant=stable
```
sam: Good. Two manual gates: 1) Post-canary metric signoff from eng-runtime and eng-router. 2) Console team confirms no schema drift in UI.
elaine: Also preflight: run small synthetic suite against canary endpoints. I pushed a script to ci/release/synth_canary.sh — please run it in the canary window.
deploy-bot: Canary 1/4 started (2 pods, 10%). Trace sample check running.
deploy-bot: Canary 1/4: trace sample mismatch 0.3% (ok), errors 0.2%, p50 delta +8ms.
nate: That p50 delta is expected with kernel warm-up. Keep an eye on p99.
deploy-bot: Canary 2/4 started (10%).
deploy-bot: Canary 2/4: errors 0.9%, p50 delta +12ms, p99 delta +40ms.
ops-oncall: p99 +40ms is borderline. How many traces show backend vs router origin?
elaine: Most p99 explainers point to router header parsing spike — route header-split config may need a small backoff.
sam: Stop the wave if error rate >2% OR p99 >100ms or request-rate drops. Current numbers ok but watch.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% starting.
maria: Console team saw no schema changes in samples. Release-note blurb ready to paste after final.
ops-oncall: If we need to rollback, prefer pinning router first (fastest path) then runtime. Router pin is low-risk revert.
elaine: Agree. Router rollback steps tested in staging.
sam: Final call: proceed with ramp if no regression in next 10m. If p99 persists >60ms, hold and triage.
deploy-bot: 50% ramp in progress. Expected completion 05:18 UTC.
deploy-bot: Full deploy complete. All checks green.
maria: Posting release note now: "Kernel batching improvements + router header-split. No observable client impact in canaries; continuous rollout completed."
ops-oncall: Marking this as release-OK. I'll follow up with a perf watch for 24h. :eyes:
elaine: Nice work team. If any late regressions appear, follow rollback snippet above and ping ops-oncall.
sam: Thanks everyone. Documenting canary metrics in the release thread and closing. :rocket:
